title: Ice Blade
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kyoya Ida is a hard-nosed Shinjuku police detective known for using lethal force to solve cases when legal means reach a dead end; this makes him unpopular with officers and the National Police Agency, though some admire him (AniList/MU description). An episodic seinen crime and psychological series (MU genres Mature, Psychological), 19 volumes complete in Japan; Tokyopop released only 3 volumes in English (MU).
life_message: Justice sometimes requires a hard, solitary man willing to go past the rules (presented ambiguously).
